 Radiography Program Open Houses Planned at EFSC
October 28, 2026 
 Eastern Florida State College will host two Open Houses for its Radiography Program
 on its Melbourne Campus, located at 3865 N. Wickham Road in Bldg. 15, Room 122.
 The Open Houses have been scheduled as follows:
 Tuesday, 1 from 5-6:30 p.m.
 Wednesday, 2 from 1:30 - 3 p.m.
 Attendees will gain valuable information about the benefits of a career in Radiography
 and how this EFSC program prepares graduates for success.
 This in-person event will provide interactive, hands-on demonstrations in the lab
 and the opportunity to network with faculty, current students, and working technologists.
 Get more details and find the link to register at easternflorida.edu/go/xray .
 For additional information, contact Timothy Sear, M.S., R.T. (R), at (321) 433-5381
 or searst@easternflorida.edu .
 Media Contact: Suzanne Rains, APR, CPRC, Associate Vice President, Communications
 Office: 321-433-7022 
 Cell: 321-537-6986
